estilo: Professional 2D stickman-style cartoon illustration, clean and cinematic. Thick confident black outlines, flat cel colors with soft shading and subtle gradients, hand-inked texture strokes in the environment (wood grain, cracks, brick lines, fabric folds). Characters have big round white heads with simple black dot eyes. Richly detailed, believable backgrounds with three clear depth layers (foreground, midground, background) and slight atmospheric perspective. One strong, motivated light source per image (window light, screen glow, lamp, street light) with warm/cool contrast. Strong, varied composition and clear visual storytelling. Looks like a frame from a premium animated explainer channel, not a presentation slide.
kap: KAP, the exact character from the attached reference image: a huge round bald white head with simple black oval eyes and thick black angular eyebrows, small round white ears each with a gold hoop earring, a short white neck, an oversized black hoodie (hood down) with a thick chunky gold chain and a gold brain-shaped pendant, wide baggy black pants, black-and-white low-top sneakers without logos, simple white rounded hands, bold black outline. Chibi proportions: the head is about one third of his height. Do not redesign him: no hair, no glasses, no beard, no extra accessories, no change of outfit or colors.
formato: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920), single still image. Keep the top 12% and the bottom 20% free of important details (subtitle and app UI safe area).
negativo: photorealistic, 3D render, generic flat vector clipart, stock illustration, corporate presentation style, childish crayon drawing, empty plain background, extra characters, extra fingers, redesigned KAP, brand names or logos, watermark, random or gibberish text, blurry text, motion blur, speed lines, animation frames, comic panels.
